name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Tesla, Bridge, and Drill belong to different engineers.
Ford, Reactor, and Drill belong to different engineers.
Ford goes with at least one of Turbine or Blowtorch.
